title: Alert
lead: Get started with the alert component to show contextual information to the user such as when validating forms or showing errors based on React and Tailwind CSS

prose.text:
The alert component can be used to show a contextual text to the user such as a success or error message after form validation inside an alert box where you can choose from multiple colors, sizes, and styles.

The examples below are styled with Tailwind CSS and the reactivity is handled by React and you can also add any type of content inside the alert box.

To start using the alert box you need to import the `<Alert>` component from the `flowbite-react` package:

prose.title: Default alert
prose.text:
The default alert component is a simple alert box with a text inside it and you can use the `color` prop to change the color of the alert box and the `title` prop to add a title to the alert box.

Inside of the `<Alert>` component you can add any type of content such as text, images, or other components as they will be considered children of the alert box.

prose.title: Alert with icon
prose.text: Use the `icon` prop to add an icon to the alert box and you can use any icon from the [React Icons](https://react-icons.github.io/react-icons/) library.

prose.title: Dismissible alert
prose.text: You can use the `onDismiss` prop on the `<Alert>` component to add a dismiss button to the alert box by adding a function inside of it that will be called when the user clicks on the dismiss button.

prose.title: Rounded alert
prose.text: To make the alert box rounded you can use the `rounded` prop on the `<Alert>` component.

prose.title: Border accent
prose.text: Add a border accent to the alert box by applying the `withBorderAccent` prop on the `<Alert>` component.

prose.title: Additional content
prose.text: Add additional content by using the `additionalContent` prop and add any type of content inside of it.

prose.title: All options
prose.text: This is an example with all of the available options and props for the alert component.

prose.title: Theme
prose.text: To learn more about how to customize the appearance of components, please see the [Theme docs](/docs/customize/theme).
